title: InventionBaseFunctions
description: The fixed set of base functions every invented thing is mapped to (B2616, D827 R31): what it is for in the simplest sense. The effect in the world comes only through the properties a function grants (no thing-specific paths, D1022); new functions only by changing this data, never by the AI.

id.description: Function id; its visible name is the text key vocab.base_function.<id> (DE/EN).

description.description: What the function means, in English, for the guard's prompt (internal, ADR-0007).

grants_properties.description: Properties (vocabulary property) every thing with this function has. Empty while the vocabulary has no fitting property: the function is then only recorded.
